I need to find the NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day from the first week of August 2015 (Aug 1-7, 2015) that shows city lights on the horizon.

Please try these approaches:
1. Visit https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA_Astronomy_Picture_of_the_Day and look for the August 2015 entries
2. Search for "APOD August 2015" on any search engine or try to access the APOD archive
3. Try to fetch the raw HTML of https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/ap150801.html through https://r.jina.ai/ or similar proxy
4. Search for "site:apod.nasa.gov ap150801" or similar

The APOD URLs follow the pattern: https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/ap1508XX.html where XX is the day of month (01-07).

Report the title and description of each day's APOD, and identify which one shows "city lights on the horizon."
I'll search for the APOD entries from August 1-7, 2015 using multiple approaches in parallel.
